name: security-reverse-engineering
description: Use this skill when the user says 'reverse engineer this function', 'Ghidra decompile', 'Frida hook', 'x64 calling convention', 'PE/ELF internals', 'disassembly'. Guides software deconstruction for vulnerability research and malware analysis — static analysis, binary formats, dynamic instrumentation. Defensive and educational only; not for DRM/IP theft. Do NOT use for: malware-specific evasion internals (use security/malware-analysis-internals) or exploit theory (use security/exploit-development-concepts).
